speaker: Samantha
text: But most travel is decidedly optional. Only corporate travel, about 30 percent of trips over 50 miles, is truly compulsory. In most cases, we travel because we want to, because the annoyances of the airport are offset by the thrill of being someplace new. Because work is stressful and our blood pressure is too high and we need a vacation somewhere tropical. Because home is boring. Because the flights are on sale. Because Paris is Paris.
